intro: The gong sounds. Let the I Could Eat a Horse Games begin.
A voice booms across the arena: there will be a feast at the Cornucopia tomorrow morning. Everyone needs something. Everyone is invited.
A table rises out of the ground at the Cornucopia, stacked with packs. Each one has a name on it. The Gamemakers have very much done this on purpose.
The Gamemakers set the {zone} on fire.

perVictim.text: {X} outruns the flames.
{X} gets out with burns down one arm.
{X} doesn't make it out of the {zone}.

intro: Without warning, the {zone} bursts its banks. A brown wall of water comes through at head height.

perVictim.text: {X} grabs a tree and hangs on until it passes, then squelches away.
{X} is swept a kilometre downstream and dumped on the bank, battered and missing a shoe.
{X} goes under and doesn't come back up.

intro: A thick yellow fog rolls into the {zone}. Wherever it touches skin, the skin blisters.

perVictim.text: {X} smells it first and is already running.
{X} gets out coughing blood, with blisters up {X.their} neck.
{X} breathes it in and drops where {X.they} stand{X.s}.

intro: Something is released into the {zone}: a pack of dogs, too big, with far too many teeth, and eyes that look disturbingly familiar.

perVictim.text: {X} gets up a tree just in time and waits for them to lose interest.
{X} fights one off with {X.their} {weapon} and runs with teeth marks in {X.their} leg.
The pack catches {X}. There isn't much left.

intro: The ground shudders and half of the {zone} comes down.

perVictim.text: {X} dives clear and ends up coughing grit in a ditch.
{X} is clipped by a boulder and drags {X.themself} out with a broken arm.
{X} is buried under a few tonnes of rock. The cannon comes a minute later.

intro: The Gamemakers turn the sun up over the {zone} until the air shimmers.

perVictim.text: {X} finds shade and lies very still until it passes.
{X} collapses with heatstroke and comes round hours later, burned and confused.
{X} stops sweating, which is a bad sign, and then stops everything else.

intro: It starts raining over the {zone}. The rain smokes when it hits the ground.

perVictim.text: {X} gets under a rock overhang in time.
{X} runs for cover with {X.their} jacket over {X.their} head, and loses most of {X.their} jacket and some of {X.their} scalp.
{X} is caught in the open. It's not quick.

intro: The floor of the {zone} opens up like a mouth.

perVictim.text: {X} leaps clear and doesn't stop running for a long time.
{X} falls in and is spat back out by a geyser of mud.
{X} falls in. The ground closes again.

intro: A storm comes out of a clear sky over the {zone}, and the lightning is aimed.

perVictim.text: {X} lies flat in a ditch with {X.their} face in the mud until the storm passes. Smart.
{X} is thrown ten metres by a strike next to {X.them} and gets up with {X.their} hair standing on end.
{X} is struck directly. All that's left smells of burnt hair.

intro: A wall of fire sweeps across the {zone}. The Gamemakers are closing it for good.

perVictim.text: {X} gets out ahead of the flames.
{X} runs through a gap in the fire and comes out smoking.
{X} is trapped between the fire and the arena wall.

intro: Water pours into the {zone} from somewhere underneath. By noon it's a lake. The Gamemakers are closing it for good.

perVictim.text: {X} wades out with {X.their} pack held over {X.their} head.
{X} swims for it and loses everything {X.they} {X.was} carrying.
{X} is asleep when the water comes. {X} doesn't wake up.

intro: The Gamemakers drop the temperature across the whole arena. By nightfall the puddles are frozen solid.

perVictim.text: {X} burrows into a pile of leaves and shivers through it.
{X} zips {X.themself} into a sleeping bag and barely notices.
{X} keeps moving all night to stay warm and survives it, just.
{X} loses feeling in two fingers and doesn't get it back.
{X} lies down to rest and freezes where {X.they} lie{X.s}.

intro: The whole arena shakes. Trees come down, rocks come loose, and the ground opens in long cracks.

perVictim.text: {X} curls up in the open and waits for it to stop.
{X} runs from a falling tree and makes it by a stride.
{X} is thrown flat and gets up dizzy, but whole.
{X} is clipped by a falling branch and gets up with a cracked collarbone.
{X} is swallowed by a crack in the ground that closes again a second later.

intro: A deafening screech plays across the arena all night, from speakers hidden in the trees. Nobody sleeps.

perVictim.text: {X} stuffs moss in {X.their} ears and stares at the dark until morning.
{X} screams back at it for a while, which doesn't help.
{X} somehow sleeps through it. Nobody understands how.
{X}'s ears start bleeding around three in the morning.

intro: Every stream, pond and puddle in the arena turns a faint green overnight. The Gamemakers have done something to the water.

perVictim.text: {X} has a sealed bottle and doesn't touch the green stuff.
{X} notices the colour and goes thirsty instead.
{X} boils it twice and drinks it anyway. It's fine. Probably.
{X} drinks before noticing and spends the day doubled over.
{X} drinks deeply from the green water and doesn't wake up.

intro: A storm rolls over the entire arena: sideways rain, hail the size of teeth, and lightning that seems to be aiming.

perVictim.text: {X} finds a rock overhang and waits it out.
{X} gets soaked to the bone and pelted with hail, but lives.
{X} drinks the rain with {X.their} mouth open and calls it a win.
{X} is knocked flat by hail and gets up with a split scalp.
Lightning hits the tree {X} is sheltering under.
